search_strategy_excerpt.locator: Methods, Search strategy and selection criteria
search_strategy_excerpt.text: We searched five electronic databases from January 1, 2010 through September 30, 2021: PubMed, CINAHL (Cumulative Index to Nursing and Allied Health Literature), Global Health, The Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials and Embase (search terms in Appendix S1). We also searched the International AIDS Conference, International AIDS Society Conference on HIV Pathogenesis, Treatment, and Prevention, Conference on Retroviruses and Opportunistic Infections, and Research for Prevention Conference websites through February 2022.
